    About

    Brand Relationship Manager is a dedicated client success and communication agent designed for agencies, service providers, consultants, and companies that manage multiple clients. It centralizes client updates, communication, risk detection, and relationship management—helping businesses maintain clarity, consistency, and long-term retention.

    It transforms chaotic client notes, messages, and meetings into structured summaries, action items, and status updates. From weekly reports to follow-ups, renewal briefs, and satisfaction analysis, the agent ensures every client receives clear, professional communication without added workload.

    Built for businesses that want to reduce churn, improve communication, and strengthen client relationships, Brand Relationship Manager helps teams stay proactive, organized, and aligned inside Notion.

    Main Features

    1. Weekly Client Updates & Reporting

    Produces clear, structured client updates that outline progress, wins, issues, and next steps. Ensures consistent, high-quality communication week after week.

    2. Client Communication & Follow-Ups

    Drafts professional messages, responses, explanations, and follow-ups—delivered in three variations for different contexts. Maintains a polished and consistent tone across all communication.

    3. Satisfaction Monitoring & Risk Detection

    Analyzes client interactions for dissatisfaction indicators or communication gaps. Highlights risks, red flags, and recommended actions to prevent churn and maintain strong relationships.
